dialect.detail: Likely compiled with GnuCOBOL (OpenCOBOL) or a compatible PC-based COBOL compiler; SOURCE-COMPUTER/OBJECT-COMPUTER set to IBM-PC; uses SCREEN SECTION with FOREGROUND-COLOR/BACKGROUND-COLOR clauses typical of GnuCOBOL or Micro Focus on PC

purpose.domain_detail: Student exercise for a French-language COBOL course (ETE 2015), managing an employee file with add/modify/delete operations
purpose.summary: TP3 (Travaux Pratiques 3) is a student exercise program that maintains an indexed employee file (EMPLOYES.DAT). It provides a menu-driven screen interface for adding, modifying, and deleting employee records, with input validation for fields such as sex, region, hourly rate, hours, and hire date.

notable_features: INDEXED file organization with ALTERNATE RECORD KEYs and DUPLICATES
88-level condition names used extensively for validation
Recursive PERFORM pattern (no GOTO) for menu loops and validation retries
verdict.notes: Program is authored by 'GABRIEL PARIAT' dated summer 2015, clearly a student practical assignment (TP = Travaux Pratiques). Source was truncated at 16000 chars but the visible portion covers the main logic. The DATA DIVISION indicator shows false for the mechanical scan but the source clearly contains FILE SECTION and WORKING-STORAGE SECTION under an implicit DATA DIVISION. Level-number 7 used instead of standard 07 in a couple of places, which is non-standard but accepted by some compilers.
